text: Credential theft indicators include username, email, password, PIN, OTP, security answer, recovery code and sign-in forms.
Financial fraud indicators include card number, CVV, expiry, bank account, transfer, payment, invoice, cryptocurrency, reward or investment solicitation.
Malware distribution indicators include download, install, update, APK, executable, attachment, document viewer, antivirus alert or software prompt.
Personal information harvesting indicators include address, phone, date of birth, identity number, passport, tax ID, employment, demographic or health data.
